Stock requests

A practical guide for
Sales and SCM

Regular stock transfers and special vendor enquiries, from the first request to the saved order result.

R

Regular stock

Request existing inventory from another yard.

Pickup / Delivery: approval → Sales SO → confirmed routing

Stocking: SCM review → adjusted items → direct TO

S

Special stock

Ask SCM to source a customer’s special items.

Vendor check → customer decision → SO → PO → readiness and fulfillment

Screens show the deployed application with fictional training customers, products, quantities and order references. They illustrate separate workflow states; they are not live orders. Buttons depend on your role and the request’s status.

Find the right workflow

The former direct-TO Pickup option is now Stocking. Regular Pickup uses pre-approval and a Sales SO.

NeedUseWhat happens next
Existing stock at another yard; delivery requiredRegular → DeliveryApproval checks, then Sales links an SO and confirms a location change or TO.
Existing stock for customer pickupRegular → PickupPre-approval → Sales SO → routing confirmation. No minimum lead time.
Stock for the Sales yard; direct transfer neededRegular → StockingSCM always reviews, adjusts items and creates the TO directly. No Sales SO.
Vendor-sourced or specially specified productsSpecialSCM checks the vendor, Sales records the customer’s decision, then SO/PO processing follows.

Open requests and find your work

Open Request Stock from the Sales menu, or the stock request page in SCM. Switch between Special and Regular.

  1. Choose the tab and a queue or stage. Search and use the yard/vendor filters to narrow the list.
  2. Select a request card. Read the details, status and next available action on the right. Use Refresh when you need the latest state.
  3. Check the alert buttons at the top. Regular decisions and special workflow alerts are separate. In Special, My requests filters to your cases.
Make the page easier to read

Special request details have −, + and Reset text-size controls. Your choice is remembered in this browser. The page also offers English and Chinese.

MBBSSTOCK REQUESTS · USER MANUAL
Regular · SalesSales

Submit a regular stock request

  1. Choose Regular and start a new request. Confirm Your destination yard; it must be a yard you are authorized to use.
  2. Enter the customer if known. Choose Pickup, Delivery or Stocking. Only Delivery shows and requires arrival date and time, in Toronto time; entries format automatically. Pickup and Stocking need neither field.
  3. Search the item, choose Request from yard, and enter the quantity. Use the available PLT/LYR/SEC/PCS conversions, or the sales-quantity field when provided.
  4. Use Add another line if needed, add any remarks, then select Submit request. Read the resulting review route.
Read availability in the correct unit

The yard cards show sales quantity and available package conversions. Live − reserved is the requestable amount. Approval does not itself commit stock; NetSuite commits it when the SO or TO is processed.

Before the first decision, use Edit request or Cancel request when available.

Regular · ApprovalSales + SCM

Understand automatic approval

Pickup and Delivery can receive automatic pre-approval. Stocking always requires SCM review.

  1. Stock request auto-approval is switched on.
  2. For Delivery, expected arrival is at least the configured lead time after submission. Pickup has no minimum lead time.
  3. Every item at each source yard has enough available stock to leave at least its safety stock after the requested quantity is shipped.
AvailableSafety stockRequestedAfter shipmentStock test
1,000800200800Pass — equal to safety stock is allowed
1,000800201799Manual review — short by 1

Quantities on matching item/source lines are added together for this check. If the stock policy or evidence needed for automatic approval is unavailable, SCM reviews the request.

Stocking always goes to SCM

Choose Stocking for SCM’s direct TO workflow. Stocking always requires manual review, even with sufficient stock.

SCM settings

SettingVerified on 29 Sep 2026Effect
Stock request auto-approvalOnOff sends Pickup and Delivery to SCM; Stocking is always manual.
Lead time12 hoursDelivery only. Pickup has no minimum lead time; Stocking is manual.
Approval validity15 minutesPickup and Delivery: the window starts when all items are reviewed.

Authorized SCM users can edit these values in Smart SCM → Settings and select Save settings. Use the values recorded on the request when reviewing older cases. The verified Delivery lead time is 12 hours; Pickup is exempt.

Regular · SCMSCM

Decide lines and manage replenishment

  1. Select the actionable lines you intend to decide. Check source yards, quantities and evidence. If you edit a line, select Save line adjustment before deciding it.
  2. Choose one of the approval options below, or reject the selected/actionable lines. Enter a rejection reason; add an approval note when useful.
  3. Finish decisions on all lines. Sales receives an alert for manual approval or rejection. Pickup / Delivery SO processing waits until all line decisions are complete.
ActionResult
Approve · TO / location changeApproved Pickup / Delivery items follow Sales SO routing and confirmation.
Approve · source replenishment POUses the same Pickup / Delivery SO route and adds priority replenishment for the corresponding item/source in Smart SCM.
Reject selected / Reject all actionableRejected lines do not proceed. Rejecting every actionable line closes the request’s stock path.
Stocking uses its own action

For Stocking, use Convert to TO to review and issue the transfer directly. See pages 11–13.

Priority replenishment

These loads carry forward into subsequent proposal runs, including for paused items, until SCM selects Release. Review the proposal’s quantity: replenishment follows the current inventory position and target, so it may differ from the original request quantity.

What Release means

Release ends the priority carry-forward. It does not cancel a PO that has already been created.

Regular · SalesSales

Link an SO and confirm a location change

  1. For an approved Pickup or Delivery request, create and save the SO at your Sales location, with open, unfulfilled stock lines at that yard.
  2. Enter its SO number and select Review SO routing before approval expires. If Select SO line appears, choose the correct matching line and review again.
  3. Read the confirmation. If all SO stock items are covered by one source yard, the app proposes changing the SO location to that yard.
  4. Confirm to apply the displayed change, or select Cancel to leave it unprocessed.
PALLET and other accompanying lines

PALLET, discount, subtotal and delivery-fee lines do not count as requested stock when deciding the route. They do not force a TO. The location-change action includes the accompanying SO lines as applicable.

29 September 2026 · Regular · Sales08 / 28
MBBSSTOCK REQUESTS · USER MANUAL
Regular · SalesSales + SCM

When the app creates Transfer Orders

The app proposes TOs to the Sales yard when the approved stock has multiple source yards, or the SO includes other stock items beyond the approved request.

SO and request situationExpected action
All SO stock items approved from 3445; Sales yard 2967Change SO location to 3445.
Approved items from 3445 and 150; Sales yard 2967Create TOs from the source yards to 2967.
Some SO stock is already at 2967; approved requested stock is from 3445Transfer the approved requested stock to 2967.
SO also contains PALLET, discount, subtotal or delivery feeThese companion lines alone do not change the stock-routing decision.

Two approved lines and one rejected line

Wait for all three decisions. Only the approved quantities may use the request. If the SO still includes the third stock item, it remains outside this approval and the app uses the transfer route for the approved items. If the SO contains only the two approved stock items from one source, a location change may apply.

Exact quantities and one SO per request

The SO must match the approved stock quantities and units. For example, 760 EACH approved versus 912 EACH on the SO is rejected with the item and quantity difference. Correct the SO or obtain a new approval for the intended quantity. An SO already used by another regular request cannot be reused.

Regular · Follow-upSales + SCM

Wait, retry and read the saved result

While processing

The busy dialog explains what is happening. Buttons are disabled to prevent duplicate actions. Wait for the result.

If an operation needs attention, reopen the same request and use its available retry action. An operation that already started can resume its saved work; do not create a second request to repeat it.

Unused Pickup or Delivery approval expired

  1. Open the expired request and select Re-raise request.
  2. Review the new result. The app rechecks the eligible previously approved items against current rules and stock evidence, plus arrival timing for Delivery.
  3. Proceed only under the new approval. Previously rejected items are not automatically reopened.

What stays visible afterward

The request keeps its confirmed action, affected location or TO references, final quantities and completion information. Completed stock evidence is the snapshot for that action; it is not recalculated by subtracting the old request from today’s stock.

Safety stock is a threshold

Closing an SO does not itself change the safety-stock requirement. Current availability may change, while the completed request retains its historical evidence. An issued TO is not proof that the physical transfer or delivery has finished.

Regular · StockingSCM

SCM opens conversion and adds items

Every Stocking request requires SCM review. SCM creates the TO directly; Sales does not enter an SO or confirm an SO-routing popup.

  1. Open the Stocking request and select Convert to TO. The editor contains its actionable items.
  2. Adjust each source yard and quantity. Check the calculated transfer quantity in the sales unit.
  3. To add stock, type an item code or description in Add an item, then choose a matching autocomplete result. Reject any original request line that should not proceed before conversion.

Regular · StockingSCM

Check final quantities and pallets

Review every original and added item. Set the PALLET quantity for each TO route; the app calculates a suggestion where conversions are available. Adjust it to the actual load.

There is one TO per source yard. Destination remains the request’s Sales yard. Once conversion has started, use its saved retry flow; the issued plan is no longer freely editable.

Regular · StockingSCM + Sales

Confirm TO creation and check the result

SCM selects Review and convert to TO. The app refreshes the stock evidence and presents a centered confirmation with the routes, quantities, pallets and safety-stock position.

Wait for NetSuite. The final request records the adjusted items and TO references so Sales and SCM can read what was done.

Follow the same request if a retry is needed

The retry continues unfinished work from the saved conversion and preserves completed TOs. Stocking conversion does not use the Sales SO approval-expiry countdown.

Open a special case

Use Special for a vendor enquiry with product specifications. A case may contain several items from the same vendor.

  1. Select New Special case. Choose the inquiry store, inquiry date and NetSuite Sales Rep.
  2. Enter the customer and vendor. Use directory suggestions when available; an enquiry may begin with a typed name. Check the customer phone and notes.
  3. Set the expiry date and choose the fulfillment method. The expiry normally starts one calendar month after the inquiry date.
Special delivery methodMeaning
Customer pickup at vendor yardCustomer collects directly from the vendor; SCM supplies the pickup location.
Pickup at inquired yardThe customer collects at the enquiry’s yard after the stock is arranged there.
DeliveryEnter the delivery address and any date, time window and instructions.
Enquiry customer versus SO account

The original customer remains on the case. At the SO step, select the actual NetSuite billing/customer account; it can be different from the enquiry contact.

Special · SalesSales

Describe, price and submit the items

  1. Enter product name, colour, size and detailed specification. Make the description specific enough for SCM to check the correct product.
  2. Enter quantity, Sales UOM and sales rate per unit. Set a discount if applicable and review the subtotal before tax.
  3. Set the required date and any line note or packaging quantities. Use Add line for more items from this vendor.
  4. Use Preview quote to check the customer-facing document, then select Submit to SCM. A preview alone does not submit the enquiry.

Pricing example

2 PLT × $520 × (1 − 5%) = $988 before tax. This is the material subtotal. Pallet charges or delivery charges are added separately at the SO step.

Dates and packaging

The application’s delivery rule requires at least three working days after SO creation, excluding weekends and the Ontario holidays in its calendar. A later SO creation date may require a later preferred delivery date. Verify UOM and packaging; 2 PLT and 40 PC may describe the same material quantity.

The saved case offers document previews where available. Use the preview dialog’s Download PDF option to save a copy.

Preview the quote and packing quantities

  1. Use Preview quote before submitting, or Preview saved quote on a saved case before SO creation.
  2. Check the customer, Sales Rep, item description, sales quantity, rate, discount and total.

Use Download PDF to save the preview. Once an SO exists, use its order preview.

Special · SCMSCM

Record the vendor stock check

  1. Open the special case in New Enquiry and check each requested item with the vendor.
  2. Set its supply status. Confirm the vendor and pickup location. Provide an ETA when the item must wait.
  3. Write the customer-facing information in Sales-visible reply. Keep private purchasing notes in SCM internal note.
  4. Select Save stock check to publish the responses to Sales.
Supply statusWhat to record
In stockConfirm the available product and vendor pickup location.
Wait For ProductionEnter the expected date and explain the production delay.
Wait for TransferEnter the expected date and explain the transfer delay.
No stock or ETAExplain the unavailable supply; Sales cannot accept an undated unavailable item.

The SCM internal note is hidden from Sales. Use the Sales-visible reply for information the customer needs to decide.

29 September 2026 · Special · SCM17 / 28
MBBSSTOCK REQUESTS · USER MANUAL
Special · SalesSales

Record the customer’s decision

When the case reaches Await Customer Confirmation, review the vendor response and discuss the product, quantity and timing with the customer.

  1. For available stock, choose Customer confirms. For dated future stock, choose Customer will wait for ETA only after the customer agrees.
  2. If the customer will not proceed, choose the decline option and enter a reason. Add a customer note when useful.
  3. Select Save customer decisions. Complete decisions on all lines before creating the SO.
  4. Only accepted materials move into the SO draft. Declined items remain on the enquiry record.
Do not treat an ETA as a pickup confirmation

Customer acceptance allows the order process to continue. SCM must still confirm actual stock readiness before collection or Dispatch can proceed.

If the vendor changes the answer later

A vendor change after PO creation can require Sales to record customer acknowledgement. Read the change, contact the customer and save the acknowledgement on the case. The existing orders and Dispatch arrangement are not silently rewritten by that vendor update.

Special · SalesSales

Prepare the SO account and fulfillment

After customer decisions are complete, use Create or link Sales Order for the accepted materials.

  1. Choose a valid NetSuite customer account from the search suggestions. A typed enquiry name alone is not an SO account selection.
  2. Confirm the NetSuite Sales Rep and Operational yard.
  3. Check the fulfillment method. For Delivery, verify the address, preferred date, time window, contact information and instructions.
  4. Attach delivery photos or video where useful. Then review the material and charge lines on the next page.
Keep the customer’s contact details useful

Use a reachable contact and practical delivery instructions. The original enquiry customer stays visible even when the SO uses a separate trade account.

Special · SalesSales

Save the draft, then create or link the SO

  1. Check the material description, quantity, fixed original rate, discount and converted NetSuite quantity. Set Pallets needed; 0 omits PALLET. Positive pallet quantity requires its unit price.
  2. Use Add ancillary item for delivery charges or other appropriate charges. Select Save SO draft. Any later edit must be saved again.
  3. Choose Create in NetSuite, or search for a compatible active SO and use Link existing SO. If a linked estimate is available, the source selector also offers estimate transformation.
Skip buttons are for testing only

If Skip SO creation or Skip PO Creation appears, it is a test option. It does not create a real order and does not enter live Dispatch. For a real customer order, use the NetSuite create/link path.

Special · SCMSCM

Review and create the PO

  1. Wait until the linked SO is approved/active in NetSuite. Open Review and create Purchase Order.
  2. Check description, quantity and UOM. These reviewed values update the SO first; the customer’s Sales prices stay unchanged.
  3. Enter unit purchase cost before vendor discount and the vendor discount percentage for every line. Enter 0 when there is no vendor discount.
  4. Select Create PO in NetSuite. If the operation needs attention, use Recover PO operation on the same case.

PO reference / packing slip

The reference is shared with PO Split and the PO/TO Schedule. A blank custom reference uses the PO number.

Sales and vendor discounts are separate

The customer’s discount belongs to the SO. The vendor discount belongs to the PO. Review each line’s figures; the resulting order may combine discounts into a single discount line.

Special · SCMSCM

Check PO approval and stock readiness

Confirmed does not mean ready for Dispatch. The case waits for confirmed PO approval, then follows the readiness and fulfillment route.

Use Save stock check after updating readiness. A reminder starts three weekdays before the ETA. Once due, it remains active until SCM explicitly confirms readiness; moving the ETA alone does not clear it.

Check both kinds of status

The case stage describes the special-request workflow. Dispatch planning separately shows whether the SO or PO has been assigned to a plan. Read both before promising a collection or delivery.

Special · FulfillmentSales + SCM

Update delivery or complete vendor pickup

Sales can update the fulfillment method and delivery details while the case is active and unplanned. Choose the method in the case summary, edit the details and select Save.

When editing is locked

SO/PO planning or an active/completed handoff can lock these details. Coordinate the change with SCM and Dispatch instead of opening a duplicate case.

Customer pickup at vendor yard

After the PO is approved and all accepted items are ready, Sales records the actual pickup date and pickup reference / evidence, then selects Complete vendor pickup.

For Pickup at inquired yard and Delivery, follow the Dispatch arrangement and planning status. Creating the SO or PO alone does not mean the customer has received the stock.

Special · ChangesSales + SCM

Request and review an order adjustment

  1. Sales opens Request an order adjustment, changes the accepted quantity, discount and/or PALLET quantity, and selects Request adjustment. Original rates stay fixed.
  2. SCM reviews the before/after package quantities and the converted SO/PO quantities. Add a review note and choose Confirm adjustment or Reject adjustment.
  3. Wait for the update result. Order creation and Dispatch wait for required SCM confirmation. If only part of the update finishes, use Retry order update until both orders are verified.
Review material quantity and PALLET separately

Product packaging and the chargeable PALLET line are separate values. Check both. A failed or partial remote update stays pending; it is not a reason to issue a second SO or PO.

Special · ClosureSales + SCM

Close a case and keep the record

Case positionClosure path
No issued SO or POEnter a close reason and use Close case.
SO issued, no POUse the available Close SO and case action and provide the reason.
PO issuedSales requests closure; SCM reviews and confirms closure of the SO and PO.
Already planned, completed, or blocked by another operationResolve the planning/operation state with SCM and Dispatch first. The closure action may be unavailable.

A closure that has started in NetSuite can require a retry. The case is not marked closed until the required order closures are verified. A closure already being applied cannot simply be rejected halfway through.

Special case expiry

The case’s expiry date controls an unissued enquiry. Automatic expiry applies only while no SO or PO exists. Sales can update the expiry where the field is available. This is separate from the regular Pickup / Delivery approval’s short validity window.

Documents and history

Use quote or order preview actions where offered, then Download PDF. Check order references, planning status and the audit trail before following up. Sales sees the relevant quote/SO documents; SCM can preview linked SO/PO documents from the case.

ReferenceSales + SCM

Read stages, queues and alerts

Special stages

StageMeaning / next owner
New EnquirySCM checks vendor supply and replies.
Await Customer ConfirmationSales records the customer decisions and prepares the SO.
ConfirmedThe case is in its order-processing stage. Check SO/PO approval and any pending SCM action.
Wait for production / TransferAccepted stock is not yet ready; SCM checks ETA and readiness.
Dispatch ArrangementReady for the relevant Dispatch arrangement; check whether a plan exists.
CompletedThe operational completion has been recorded.
ClosedThe enquiry/order path was closed, such as by cancellation, decline or expiry.

Alerts

WhoWhat to watch
Sales · RegularUnread manual approval/rejection decisions. Open the request to read the decision and next action.
SCM · RegularNew requests requiring manual review, including every Stocking request.
Sales · SpecialOwn requests at Await Customer Confirmation, Dispatch Arrangement or Wait for production / Transfer.
SCM · SpecialNew enquiries and confirmed cases; also read case-card reminders for readiness, order adjustment and closure.

Special alert counts reflect workflow stages; they are not simply unread-message counts. A case can remain on an alert list while that stage still applies.

Regular queues and line status

Sales uses Pending, Accepted and Completed; SCM also has review, approved, pending-TO, rejected and closed queues. Read individual line decisions and the saved SO/TO action when a request has mixed outcomes.

Queue labels are not delivery receipts

An accepted request or created TO may still require physical movement and receiving. Check the transfer, Dispatch or collection result to establish fulfillment.

ReferenceSales + SCM

Resolve common problems

What you seeWhat to do
Pickup or Delivery needs manual reviewRead the reason: auto-approval off, stock below safety or missing evidence. Delivery also checks lead time; Pickup has no minimum lead time.
A Stocking request did not auto-approveExpected behavior. SCM must review and convert it directly to TO.
SO quantity differs from approvalCompare the item, unit and totals in the error. 912 against 760 approved is 152 too many. Correct the SO or request approval for the intended quantity.
SO has PALLET, discount, subtotal or delivery-fee linesThese are accompanying lines, not requested stock. Check the actual material lines to understand the proposed route.
SO number is already usedOpen its existing regular request. Use a different eligible SO for a separate request.
Approval has expiredUse Re-raise request for an unused Pickup or Delivery approval. Recheck the new review result before proceeding.
Waiting for NetSuite / buttons disabledWait for the operation. If attention or a retry action appears, continue on the same request.
SO changed while being checkedRefresh the request, finish any concurrent SO edits, then run Review SO routing again. Read the newly validated action before confirming.
Special “Create in NetSuite” is disabledSelect a valid customer account and Sales Rep, complete required fields, and Save SO draft. Resolve any pending SCM quantity review.
Special PO cannot be createdCheck that the SO is approved and the vendor is valid. Complete purchase costs and each vendor discount field, including 0 when no discount applies.
PO exists but the case is still ConfirmedCheck the PO approval notice. Dispatch/readiness progression waits for confirmed NetSuite approval.
Readiness alert remains after changing ETASCM must confirm Ready for collection when the goods are actually ready. A new ETA does not clear a reminder already due.
Delivery method or closure is unavailableCheck planning, completion, pending adjustments and any attention message. Coordinate the existing case with SCM/Dispatch.
An unfamiliar error persistsGive SCM/support the request reference, SO/PO/TO reference, exact message and action attempted. Preserve the existing request so its saved operation can be checked.

Never assume an interrupted browser operation failed to create its order. Check the saved request and references before retrying.

ReferenceSales + SCM

Daily checklist and terminology

Sales

  • Choose Regular or Special correctly.
  • Confirm yard, item, unit, quantity and timing.
  • For regular Pickup / Delivery, create the SO at your Sales yard and match the approval.
  • Read the routing confirmation before acting.
  • For special enquiries, save the customer’s actual decision.
  • Check the SO account, selling price, discount, pallets and delivery details.
  • Read alerts and the final saved result.

SCM

  • Check the reason for manual review and safety stock on each regular line.
  • Finish all required line decisions.
  • For Stocking, review edited/added items and PALLET quantities before issuing TOs.
  • Review priority replenishment and release it explicitly when appropriate.
  • For special cases, confirm vendor, ETA and pickup location.
  • Check PO costs/discounts and approval.
  • Resolve readiness, adjustment and closure actions.
TermMeaning in this manual
Source yard / destination yardWhere regular requested stock comes from / the Sales yard receiving or requesting it.
Safety stockMinimum stock threshold used to assess the remaining source inventory after shipment.
PLT / LYR / SEC / PC or PCSPallet / layer / section / piece. Conversion depends on the item.
Sales UOMThe sales unit, such as SQFT or EACH, in which approved material quantities are compared.
PALLET lineThe separate pallet item/charge on an order; it is not a regular requested stock material.
Priority replenishmentA regular-request replenishment requirement carried into Smart SCM proposals until released.
RevisionThe saved version of a request. Refresh if someone else changed it.
Attention / recoveryAn operation needs review or a retry on the same case before it can finish.
Guide scope

This edition documents the deployed regular and special stock-request features checked on 29 September 2026. Settings and available actions can change. Read the values, reasons and confirmation shown on the actual request.
